num_patients_P: <int> Total number of patients to be scheduled in the session.
num_colonoscopy_C: <int> Number of patients receiving a colonoscopy procedure.
num_upper_endoscopy_colonoscopy_UC: <int> Number of patients receiving a combined upper endoscopy and colonoscopy procedure.
provider_service_hours_L_minutes: <int> Total length of the provider's session in minutes.
procedure_types: <list[str], length num_patients_P> Type of procedure for each patient, either colonoscopy ('C') or combined upper endoscopy and colonoscopy ('UC').

{cost_structure_name}.c_w: <float> Per-minute cost of patient waiting time before their procedure begins.
{cost_structure_name}.c_g: <float> Per-minute cost of provider idle time between consecutive procedures.
{cost_structure_name}.c_o: <float> Per-minute cost of provider overtime beyond the scheduled session length.

patients.procedure_type: <str> Type of procedure for this patient, either colonoscopy ('C') or combined upper endoscopy and colonoscopy ('UC').
patients.mean_duration_adequate_prep: <float> Mean procedure duration in minutes when the patient has adequate bowel preparation.
patients.mean_duration_inadequate_prep: <float> Mean procedure duration in minutes when the patient has inadequate bowel preparation.
patients.lower_bound_duration_adequate_prep: <float> Lower support bound on procedure duration in minutes with adequate bowel preparation.
patients.upper_bound_duration_adequate_prep: <float> Upper support bound on procedure duration in minutes with adequate bowel preparation.
patients.lower_bound_duration_inadequate_prep: <float> Lower support bound on procedure duration in minutes with inadequate bowel preparation.
patients.upper_bound_duration_inadequate_prep: <float> Upper support bound on procedure duration in minutes with inadequate bowel preparation.
patients.mean_prep_adequacy: <float> Probability that the patient has adequate bowel preparation.
patients.mean_arrival_time_deviation: <float> Mean deviation in minutes of the patient's actual arrival time from their scheduled time.
patients.lower_bound_arrival_time_deviation: <float> Lower support bound on the patient's arrival time deviation in minutes.
patients.upper_bound_arrival_time_deviation: <float> Upper support bound on the patient's arrival time deviation in minutes.
